title: 법관의 국제기구 파견 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
title_original: 법관의 국제기구 파견 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 8 (Recall)
(1) The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court may recall a seconded judge, etc. where the judge or official is deemed to have seriously damaged his or her dignity or where it is deemed difficult to achieve the purpose of the secondment.
(2) The same shall apply where the seconded judge, etc. becomes unable to continue the seconded duties due to unavoidable circumstances, such as illness or an accident.
